name: Eoneu Nal Moreuneun Hubaega Gobaekae Watda
original_name: 어느 날 모르는 후배가 고백해 왔다
source:
One day, a junior I didn't know suddenly confessed to me!?
"Please go out with me!!"
Confession, awkward.
"Why!?"
